newsitem.title: USA: Manhattan Bagel Q3 sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Manhattan Bagel Q3 sales rise.

text.p: Manhattan Bagel Co Inc said on Friday that same store sales for its franchised units increased 1.8 percent during the third quarter.
The company said that system-wide retail sales for its chain of bagel bakeries/delicatessens increased 115 percent during the quarter over the comparable 1995 period.

As reported by the stores, unaudited system-wide sales for the chain's franchised, company-owned and licensed units rose to $23.9 million during the three months ended September 30 from $11.1 million in 1995's third quarter.

To conform with industry standards, Manhattan Bagel said it changed its method of calculating same-store sales to measure results from stores open for a year or more, as opposed to its previous practice of using stores operating for at least two full years. The change is reflected in the results reported for both the third quarter and the first nine months of 1996, but did not materially effect results.
